one_liner: Invoicing for Dutch freelancers that chases late payers for you, politely, until they pay.
description: Factuurtje creates KVK- and BTW-compliant invoices in one click and then follows up automatically: friendly reminder at day 14, firmer at day 30, a formal notice at day 45. Freelancers get paid on average 11 days faster. €12/month, first 3 invoices free.
audience: Dutch ZZP'ers (freelancers) in creative and consulting work who hate chasing invoices.
goals: 150 paying signups in the first month.
tone: calm, practical, dry humour, no hype
